relationship.outcome_raw: forage production held steady in épocas de sequía intensa in the silvopastoral system, while grass monoculture biomass fell to a quarter

context.note: likely the same El Hatico farm as the Murgueitio et al. 2011 claim in montagnini_2015_catie_es (not independent)

EV_evidence_register.quote: Asimismo, en Colombia fue posible incrementar el nivel de carga animal a 4.3 vacas ha-1 y la produc- ción de leche al 130 %, además de eliminar comple- tamente el uso de fertilizantes químicos, al emplear un SSP compuesto de pastos, árboles de tamaño grande y medio y arbustos de Leucaena. También en las épocas de sequía intensa se mantuvo cons- tante la producción de forraje y se pudo neutralizar los efectos negativos en todo el sistema silvopasto- ril, al compararse con el monocultivo de gramíneas, en el que se redujo la biomasa al 25 % (Altieri y Nicholls, 2013). (English: Likewise, in Colombia it was possible to raise stocking to 4.3 cows ha-1 and milk production to 130%, while completely eliminating chemical fertilisers, using a silvopastoral system of pastures, large and medium trees and Leucaena shrubs. Also, in periods of intense drought forage production stayed constant and the negative effects on the whole silvopastoral system could be neutralised, compared with grass monoculture, in which biomass was reduced to 25% (Altieri and Nicholls, 2013).)
EV_evidence_register.raw_name: producción de forraje en sequía intensa
EV_evidence_register.attribution: Altieri and Nicholls (2013), cited in Cisneros-Saguilan et al.

FAM_family_registry.name: Alley cropping
FAM_family_registry.definition: Planted rows of woody perennials with annual crops cultivated in the alleys between them.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Arable biophysical envelope + machinery/management access on cultivable land.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Planted silvoarable systems on cultivable land share a slope/soil/rainfall envelope and a management-access constraint; grouped by that shared limiting factor, not by tree species.

FAM_family_registry.name: Tree intercropping
FAM_family_registry.definition: Planted trees dispersed within or among annual crops on cultivable land.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Arable biophysical envelope + management access on cultivable land.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Same planted-on-cropland envelope as alley cropping; same dominant limiting factor.

FAM_family_registry.name: Planted boundary / live fence on cropland
FAM_family_registry.definition: Deliberately planted tree/shrub lines on the boundaries of cultivated fields.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Arable biophysical envelope + management access; established by planting.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Planted establishment on cropland places it in the silvoarable envelope family (distinct from F4, where the limiting factor is linear placement geometry rather than the arable envelope).

FAM_family_registry.name: Farmer-managed natural regeneration (FMNR)
FAM_family_registry.definition: Re-establishing tree cover by protecting and managing natural regrowth from living stumps, roots and seed, rather than planting.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Regeneration potential — remnant rootstock, seedbank, seed-source proximity, and tenure security to protect regrowth.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Limited by regeneration potential, not the planting envelope; a different variable set (woody-cover baseline/change, seed-source distance, tenure), so it cannot be an override of F1.

FAM_family_registry.name: Parkland tree retention
FAM_family_registry.definition: Retaining/regenerating scattered mature trees on cropland (e.g. Faidherbia parkland) by protecting natural regeneration.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Regeneration potential + tenure (retention/ANR), not deliberate planting.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Retained parkland is regeneration-driven (kin to ANR/FMNR); a planted parkland would instead sit in F1. Keyed by establishment driver, not appearance.

FAM_family_registry.name: Assisted natural regeneration on farmland
FAM_family_registry.definition: Active assistance (weeding, protection, thinning) to accelerate natural regeneration on farmland.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Regeneration potential — seedbank/rootstock, seed source, tenure.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Same regeneration-potential limiting factor as FMNR and parkland retention.

FAM_family_registry.name: Planted silvopasture
FAM_family_registry.definition: Deliberate integration of planted trees with pasture and grazing livestock.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Biophysical envelope PLUS grazing context and forage/livestock variables.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Needs additional variables (forage, grazing pressure, livestock) beyond the silvoarable envelope; overrides only re-parameterise existing variables, so it is its own family.

FAM_family_registry.name: Agrosilvopasture
FAM_family_registry.definition: Combined trees + crops + livestock on the same land unit.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Envelope + grazing context + forage/livestock variables.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Shares the grazing-context limiting factor with planted silvopasture.

FAM_family_registry.name: Windbreaks & shelterbelts
FAM_family_registry.definition: Tree/shrub lines positioned to reduce wind exposure across fields.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Linear-feature geometry — wind exposure and field-boundary placement.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Placement (line within a candidate zone) is the limiting logic, not arable envelope; footprint reported as candidate length/density, never pixel area.

FAM_family_registry.name: Contour & vegetative buffers
FAM_family_registry.definition: Tree/shrub lines along contours or slope-flow lines to reduce erosion and runoff.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Linear-feature geometry — slope/flow lines + boundary placement.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Same linear-placement limiting factor as windbreaks; candidate length/density footprint.

FAM_family_registry.name: Shaded perennial-crop system
FAM_family_registry.definition: Shade trees grown over an existing perennial cash crop. The understorey crop (coffee, cocoa, tea, cardamom, pepper, ...) is a PARAMETER of the family, scoped per AOI - not a separate subpractice.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: The host crop's observed distribution / production (where the crop is actually grown), plus shade-as-adaptation at the climate-stressed edge.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: One family, crop as a parameter (run per candidate crop, combine by max retaining the driving crop) - the way F1 is not split by tree species. Gated by the crop's observed distribution (MapSPAM / GAEZ / EO commodity maps / ag-stats), not a modelled niche; bioclimatic-envelope modelling is the fallback only where distribution data are absent. Crops are not blended into one envelope (coffee highlands and cocoa lowlands are nearly disjoint).

FAM_family_registry.name: Multistrata homegardens
FAM_family_registry.definition: Intensive multistrata tree-crop-livestock gardens adjacent to dwellings.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Settlement and water proximity at sub-pixel scale.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Sub-pixel and proximity-driven; a raster suitability surface misleads, so handled qualitatively via the scorecard + M6 note rather than mapped.

FAM_family_registry.name: Macro-catchment water harvesting
FAM_family_registry.definition: Structures that collect runoff from a catchment larger than the cultivated/storage area (e.g. check dams, farm ponds).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Runoff generation + storable terrain (slope, drainage, soil permeability).
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Runoff-catchment WH practices share a runoff-generation + storage-terrain limiting factor; reported as an applicability zone, not pixel area.

FAM_family_registry.name: Cross-cutting envelope (family-agnostic)
FAM_family_registry.definition: Tagging value for evidence applying across ALL agroforestry families (e.g. general biophysical envelope claims), not one subpractice. Not a real subpractice.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: (cross-cutting — applies to all families)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Meta-tag (v0.3.2, pending ratification) so general envelope evidence is not force-pinned to F1; see methodology/schema_changes.

FAM_family_registry.name: Passive natural regeneration
FAM_family_registry.definition: Forest recovery by spontaneous regeneration after the degrading pressure is removed; no planting or active management.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: regeneration potential: seed-source/remnant proximity, residual woody cover, low disturbance, pressure-removal feasibility
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Restoration continuum passive end; limited by natural regeneration potential not planting. Grounded stocktake 'natural regeneration' rows + distance-from-remnants variable.

FAM_family_registry.name: Secondary succession
FAM_family_registry.definition: Unassisted secondary forest succession on abandoned/degraded land.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: same as passive regeneration — spontaneous recovery gated by regeneration potential
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Grouped with passive regeneration: identical limiting factor (natural propagule supply + low disturbance).

FAM_family_registry.name: Assisted natural regeneration (ANR)
FAM_family_registry.definition: Accelerate natural regeneration by removing barriers (weeding, fire/grazing protection, liberation thinning, releasing wildlings); relies on natural propagules, not planting.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: partial regeneration potential + intervention feasibility (access/labour/management)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Distinct from passive (needs active intervention + access) and from planting (no planting). Middle of the restoration continuum.

FAM_family_registry.name: Reforestation
FAM_family_registry.definition: Deliberate tree planting to re-establish forest on formerly forested land.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: planting envelope for target species/community + degradation too high for natural regen
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Active-planting family; reforestation vs afforestation is a prior-land-cover flag, not a separate family (same planting limiting factor).

FAM_family_registry.name: Afforestation
FAM_family_registry.definition: Tree planting to establish forest on land not recently forested.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: planting envelope for target species + site not previously forest (do-no-harm caveat on non-forest ecosystems)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Grouped with reforestation/enrichment under active planting; prior land cover is a context flag.

FAM_family_registry.name: Enrichment planting
FAM_family_registry.definition: Planting target species into degraded/secondary forest to restore composition/structure.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: planting envelope + existing degraded canopy (partial cover)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Active-planting intervention within existing degraded forest; shares the planting limiting factor.

FAM_family_registry.name: Mangrove restoration
FAM_family_registry.definition: Restoration of mangrove/coastal forested wetlands by planting or hydrology restoration.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: coastal hydrology: tidal hydroperiod, salinity, intertidal elevation, sediment supply, wave energy
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Distinct coastal-hydrology limiting factor. PARKED from discovery pending scope decision (coastal vs rural-terrestrial scan).

FAM_family_registry.name: Ecological mangrove restoration (EMR)
FAM_family_registry.definition: Restore tidal hydrology and let mangroves regenerate naturally rather than mass-planting.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: coastal hydrology restoration feasibility (hydroperiod/elevation) + natural propagule supply
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Grouped with mangrove restoration (same coastal-hydrology driver). PARKED from discovery pending scope decision.

FAM_family_registry.name: Forest protection / avoided degradation
FAM_family_registry.definition: Protecting existing forest under threat from degradation/deforestation.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: existing standing forest x degradation/deforestation pressure x governance feasibility (governance is soft -> M2b, not T4)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Not new establishment; applies within existing-forest mask. PARKED from discovery pending scope decision (restoration family vs separate avoided-deforestation stream).

FAM_family_registry.name: Community-based forest management
FAM_family_registry.definition: Community/collective management of forest for protection and sustainable use.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: existing forest + community tenure/governance feasibility (soft enabling-env -> M2b)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Grouped with protection: same standing-stock+governance driver. PARKED from discovery pending scope decision.

FAM_family_registry.name: Contour bunds / ridges
FAM_family_registry.definition: Earthen bunds or ridges on the contour that hold rain where it falls on the field.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: On-field water balance: rainfall deficit + soil infiltration/depth, gentle slope; placed on inter-stream slopes.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: In-situ moisture conservation: capture rain in place, no external catchment or storage; grouped by the on-field water-balance limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Planting pits / Zai
FAM_family_registry.definition: Micro-pits that concentrate water and organic matter at the planting station (Zai, tassa).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: On-field water balance in degraded/crusted soils; rainfall deficit.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: In-situ point moisture concentration; same on-field water-balance limiter as contour bunds.

FAM_family_registry.name: Conservation tillage / mulching
FAM_family_registry.definition: Residue cover and reduced tillage to cut evaporation and raise infiltration.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Soil infiltration/water-holding + rainfall deficit; low slope.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: In-situ moisture conservation via surface management; on-field water-balance limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Semi-circular bunds
FAM_family_registry.definition: Crescent bunds catching runoff from a short bare micro-catchment upslope.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Short-slope runoff:cropped-area ratio + slope/soil.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Micro-catchment: a small bare catchment feeds an adjacent basin; grouped by the short-slope runoff-ratio limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Eyebrow terraces
FAM_family_registry.definition: Small individual terraces harvesting runoff from an upslope strip.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Short-slope runoff:planted-area ratio.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Micro-catchment runoff-ratio limiter (distinct from slope-reshaping bench terraces).

FAM_family_registry.name: Runoff strips
FAM_family_registry.definition: Alternating bare runoff-donor strips and cropped receiving strips.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Runoff-donor:receiver strip ratio + slope/soil.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Micro-catchment runoff-ratio limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Farm ponds
FAM_family_registry.definition: Excavated/embanked ponds storing runoff from a larger catchment.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Runoff generation + drainage geomorphology (3rd-4th order) + soil clay for storage.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Ex-situ storage sited within candidate drainage zones; runoff+geomorphology limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Check dams
FAM_family_registry.definition: Small barriers across channels to slow flow, trap sediment and recharge.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Drainage-line geomorphology (2nd-3rd order stream) + runoff.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Ex-situ channel structure; sited on drainage lines, reported as siting density not pixel area.

FAM_family_registry.name: Percolation tanks
FAM_family_registry.definition: Impoundments designed to recharge groundwater by infiltration.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Runoff + permeable substrate/lineaments for recharge.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Ex-situ recharge structure; runoff+recharge-terrain limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Bench terraces
FAM_family_registry.definition: Level or near-level steps cut into a slope to hold water and soil.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Slope (defining, ~5-25%) + soil depth for construction.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Terracing/slope SWC: slope is the defining variable; distinct slope envelope from in-situ/ex-situ.

FAM_family_registry.name: Stone bunds / fanya juu
FAM_family_registry.definition: Contour stone bunds or fanya juu embankments that progressively terrace a slope.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Slope + stone availability + soil depth.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Slope-reshaping SWC; grouped with bench terraces by the slope-driven limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Rooftop / domestic harvesting
FAM_family_registry.definition: Cisterns/reservoirs capturing roof runoff at buildings.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Settlement/building presence (sub-pixel).
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: PARKED: settlement-driven, not a rural-landscape suitability surface (scope Q).

FAM_family_registry.name: Spate / floodwater harvesting
FAM_family_registry.definition: Diversion and spreading of ephemeral flood flows (spate irrigation, jessour, water spreading).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Ephemeral channel / wadi presence + sediment load.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: PARKED: ephemeral-channel gated; thin in stocktake; own family vs fold into ex-situ is a scope Q.

FAM_family_registry.name: Planted grass/herbaceous filter strip
FAM_family_registry.definition: Established herbaceous strip along a watercourse to intercept sediment and nutrients from adjacent runoff.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: watercourse proximity + riparian slope/width + adjacent-cropland runoff load + planting
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Planted along-stream placement gated by watercourse proximity + adjacent-land load; grass vs woody is a parameter.
references: Mayer et al. 2007 (riparian buffer N removal)

FAM_family_registry.name: Planted woody/forested riparian buffer
FAM_family_registry.definition: Established trees/shrubs along a watercourse for bank stability, shade and habitat.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: watercourse proximity + riparian slope/width + planting envelope
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Same along-stream planted placement limiter as grass strips (vegetation type = parameter).
references: Mayer et al. 2007 (riparian buffer N removal)

FAM_family_registry.name: Riparian natural regeneration
FAM_family_registry.definition: Protect/allow natural regeneration of existing riparian vegetation.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: watercourse proximity + existing riparian condition / regeneration potential + hydro-connectivity
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Restoration-based (not planted): gated by existing riparian condition/regen potential.
references: Mayer et al. 2007 (riparian buffer N removal)

FAM_family_registry.name: Riparian reforestation
FAM_family_registry.definition: Restore degraded riparian banks by re-establishing woody vegetation.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: watercourse proximity + degradation/regen potential of the riparian zone
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Grouped with natural regeneration: restoration limiter, distinct from planted-buffer establishment.
references: Mayer et al. 2007 (riparian buffer N removal)

FAM_family_registry.name: Wetland restoration / rewetting
FAM_family_registry.definition: Restore a degraded/drained wetland by restoring hydrology (block drainage, re-flood).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: former/degraded wetland extent + hydrology (water table, drainage history, connectivity)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Restore-what-was: gated by degraded wetland extent + hydrology; distinct from creating new wetlands.

FAM_family_registry.name: Drainage blocking / re-flooding
FAM_family_registry.definition: Block artificial drainage to raise the water table and re-flood a former wetland.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: drainage state + water table + former wetland extent
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Rewetting mechanism within restoration; same degraded-extent + hydrology limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Floodplain wetland reconnection
FAM_family_registry.definition: Reconnect a floodplain wetland body to its water source.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: hydro-connectivity + former floodplain-wetland extent
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Restoration by reconnection; targets the wetland body (cf. riparian streamside strip).

FAM_family_registry.name: Wetland creation
FAM_family_registry.definition: Create a new wetland where none currently exists (water storage, habitat, nutrient interception).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: water availability + low-lying/depression terrain + soil permeability + currently-not-wetland
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Siting a NEW wetland on non-wetland land: terrain/water-availability limiter, distinct from restore.

FAM_family_registry.name: Wetland reconstruction
FAM_family_registry.definition: Reconstruct/engineer a wetland form on non-wetland land.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: terrain + water availability + soil
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Grouped with creation: new-wetland siting limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Peatland rewetting
FAM_family_registry.definition: Rewet drained peatland to halt subsidence and restore peat function.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: peat soil presence + drainage state + water table
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Peat-specific: peat soil layer + subsidence + carbon make it a distinct variable set.

FAM_family_registry.name: Paludiculture
FAM_family_registry.definition: Productive use of wet/rewetted peat (wet meadow/pasture, reed).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: peat soil + high water table + suitable wet crop
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Wet farming of peat; grouped with peatland rewetting by the peat-soil + water-table limiter.

FAM_family_registry.name: Constructed / treatment wetland
FAM_family_registry.definition: Engineered wetland for point-source / agricultural-drainage treatment (e.g. HSSF-CW).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: point-source / ag-drainage load + engineered siting (area, slope, inflow)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: PARKED: treatment/engineering siting problem (peri-urban/point-source), scope Q for a rural landscape scan.

FAM_family_registry.name: Tidal marsh / coastal wetland restoration
FAM_family_registry.definition: Restore coastal tidal marsh / salt marsh.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: coastal hydrology: tidal inundation, salinity, elevation
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: PARKED: coastal-hydrology driver; same coastal scope Q as forest-restoration mangroves.

FAM_family_registry.name: Cross-cutting envelope (family-agnostic)
FAM_family_registry.definition: Tagging value for evidence applying across ALL water-harvesting / SWC families (e.g. pooled "soil and water conservation" results in syntheses and programme evaluations that do not isolate one practice), not one subpractice. Not a real subpractice.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: (cross-cutting — applies to all families)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Meta-tag mirroring agroforestry cross_cutting_envelope (2026-10-05, T3/T6 WH round 1): pooled SWC effect evidence is otherwise unregisterable (ingest gate requires a FAM id). Roll-up rows pool it with family rows; family-scope rows list it as its own scope.

FAM_family_registry.name: Sand dams
FAM_family_registry.definition: Reinforced walls across seasonal sandy riverbeds that trap sand and store water in the sediment aquifer behind them.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Drainage-line geomorphology (seasonal sandy channel, bedrock sill) + runoff.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Ex-situ channel structure sited on seasonal sand rivers; siting density, not pixel area (added 2026-10-06 from WH round 1: Ritchie 2021, Neufeld 2017; Pete ratified).

FAM_family_registry.name: Subsurface dams
FAM_family_registry.definition: Buried impermeable barriers across alluvial riverbeds that hold water in the alluvium upstream (barragens subterrâneas).
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Alluvial channel geomorphology + runoff; storage in the alluvium.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Ex-situ channel structure sited on alluvial valley bottoms; siting density, not pixel area (added 2026-10-06 from WH round 1: Cirilo 2003, Brito 2007; Pete ratified).

FAM_family_registry.name: Small communal tanks / reservoirs
FAM_family_registry.definition: Village-scale embanked tanks or small reservoirs storing runoff from a larger catchment for multiple uses.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: Runoff generation + drainage geomorphology + soil clay for storage.
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Ex-situ storage sited within candidate drainage zones; shares the farm-pond limiter at larger scale (added 2026-10-06 from WH round 1: Saruchera 2019, Verma & Shah 2019; Pete ratified).

FAM_family_registry.name: Cross-cutting envelope (family-agnostic)
FAM_family_registry.definition: Tagging value for evidence applying across ALL forest-restoration families (pooled 'restoration' results that do not isolate planting vs regeneration vs protection), not one subpractice. Not a real subpractice.
FAM_family_registry.dominant_limiting_factor: (cross-cutting — applies to all families)
FAM_family_registry.grouping_rationale: Meta-tag mirroring agroforestry / water-harvesting cross_cutting_envelope (2026-10-06, FR effect round 1): pooled restoration effect evidence is otherwise unregisterable (ingest gate requires a FAM id). Exempt from the qualitative_only parking rule (synthesise-t3t6.py).

VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Conversions declared 2026-09-29 (WH sweep): sources state soil depth in m (Krois 2014: >1.0 m) as well as cm, and without the rule the synthesiser refuses them.

VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Silvopasture-specific (F3 family). Likely not relevant to F1 silvoarable — flag for family-routing decision.

VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Mendonça (Embrapa-style) ranked classes; may be redundant with soil_texture in coarse-resolution analyses.

VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Derived from forest cover layer + patch analysis; agroforestry-priority signal (Brazilian Atlantic Forest restoration framing).

VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Nelson/Weiss accessibility surface — minutes to large town. Maps to WOCAT QM indirect driver 'm' (market access / roads). | market_access (T5/T6/BIND) consolidated here 2026-06-24 #103 — same Nelson/Weiss travel-time surface; synonymous names kept as aliases.

VONT_variable_ontology.comment: VIIRS night-lights or WB Energy grid-coverage. Maps to WOCAT QM indirect driver 'i' (infrastructure / energy).

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Market / value-chain depth
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: FAOSTAT + country-team uploads. Maps to WOCAT QM indirect driver 'm' (market access / value chain depth).

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Seasonal rural labour availability
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: ILO + LSMS-ISA. Maps to WOCAT QM indirect driver 'l' (labor availability).

VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Derived layer — recipe in methodology/farming_system_classifier.md. Run-time output, not a single dataset.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Distance to nearest settlement
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Euclidean distance to built-up/settlement. distance_to_market is SYNONYMOUS (rural settlement≈market) — folded here as an alias. Distinct from accessibility_travel_time (friction/travel-time, not euclidean). Dataset binding pending (Benson). #103.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Distance to nearest waterbody
VONT_variable_ontology.raised_by: issue_103; unit revised by the riparian T4 sweep 2026-09-25
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Outward distance from the watercourse. For riparian_buffer (spatial_product_type=zonal_linear) this is the band half-width that defines the opportunity zone, and ALL 13 evidence units state it in metres (statutory reserves 30-50 m, design widths 5-30 m, delineation maxima 200-210 m) - so the canonical unit is m, not km (changed 2026-09-25; the variable is used by no other NbS, no BIND row and no other recipe, so the change has no blast radius). min_meaningful_resolution lowered 100->30 to match the evidence. CAVEAT for dataset-fitness sign-off: a 30 m band cannot be resolved from a ~90 m global stream network - record as a scoping-grade limitation. Distinct from riparian_buffer_width, which is the width of the EXISTING buffer (a restoration-priority indicator, not the zone definition). #103.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Distance to nearest cropland
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Euclidean distance to cropland. Dataset binding pending. #103.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Distance to nearest forest
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Euclidean distance to forest/tree cover. Dataset binding pending. #103.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Riparian buffer width
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Width of the EXISTING riparian vegetation strip per reach/sub-basin (an indicator of restoration priority, not the design width of a new buffer). Raised by the riparian T4 sweep; group placement + dataset binding need sign-off. Narrow linear feature - 30 m is the coarsest meaningful run resolution.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Riparian buffer gap ratio
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Share of stream length carrying no riparian buffer. Continuity outranks width in the ES literature (cole20), so gaps are the priority restoration target. Dataset binding pending.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Natural regeneration potential
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Whether passive regeneration can be expected vs requiring active reintroduction - gated by soil seed bank depletion and limited propagule dispersal. NAME COLLISION: rootstock_presence already carries 'regeneration potential' as an alias, but that variable is FMNR living-stump specific. Reviewers to rule: keep distinct or merge.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Distance to nearest existing plantation
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Proximity to existing plantations as a proxy for seed, nursery and labour supply for planted restoration (Bukoski 2024 screens out plantation beyond 40 km). Operational rather than biophysical - extracted as use_role=operational_risk. Dataset binding pending.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Human population density
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Local human population density bands the restoration opportunity (wide-scale below 10/km2 vs mosaic 10-100/km2; Chazdon & Guariguata 2016). context_sensitivity=high: nationally derived, so the scoping output should recommend a country-endorsed source. Dataset binding pending.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Topographic wetness index
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: ln(upslope contributing area / tan slope) from a DEM - delineates saturation-prone ground for wetland restoration siting (Russell 1997 carries forward only the medium and high classes). Scale-dependent derivative: derive-then-aggregate, never resample a coarser index.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Minimum restorable patch area
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Minimum contiguous area for a restoration site to be worth prioritising (Russell 1997 uses 1 ha for flood attenuation, and states the threshold was arbitrarily defined). Distinct from forest_fragment_size, which measures an existing seed-source patch.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Contributing catchment area
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Area contributing runoff to a water-harvesting structure; sizes the structure to its catchment (farm ponds 1-2 ha, check dams >25 ha, percolation tanks 25-40 ha). NOTE for review: micro-catchment evidence expresses the same constraint as a transport DISTANCE (<100 m, Boers 1986), not an area - reviewers to decide whether that belongs here or in its own variable.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Soil permeability / infiltration capacity
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Rate at which water enters the soil. Directional both ways: recharge structures and slope-separated terraces WANT permeability, storage structures (farm ponds) want the opposite. Distinct from the existing soil_permeability_sensitivity index.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Soil clay content
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Percentage clay. Split out of soil_texture (a CLASS variable) because water-harvesting sources rank suitability on % clay directly (Kahinda 2008, Krois & Schulte 2014), and the unit guard correctly refused percent against a class. Directional by structure: in-field RWH peaks at 15-35% clay, ex-field at 35-55%.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Surrounding-landscape forest cover
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Forest cover in the SURROUNDING landscape (e.g. within a 1 km radius) as a seed and disperser supply for natural regeneration. Deliberately NOT tree_canopy_cover: on-site canopy must be LOW for land to be in the restoration opportunity space (<25-30%), while surrounding forest cover being HIGH is good - one variable would carry opposite signs.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Groundwater table depth (mean lowest level)
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Depth below surface of the (dry-season) groundwater table. Shallower = more rewettable peat (paludiculture). No global dataset bound yet; national groundwater-level products are typically requires_upload.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Groundwater seepage flux (upward negative)
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Vertical groundwater flux; NEGATIVE = upward (groundwater feeding the root zone, good for rewetting), positive = downward loss. Sign convention per Brouwer et al. Typically a national hydrological-model output (requires_upload).

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Tidal inundation duration
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Share of time a site is flooded by the tide - the master control on where mangroves establish (low intertidal = too long flooded). Derived from elevation relative to local tidal datums; no global dataset bound yet (local DEM + tide model, or the Mangrove Restoration Potential Map as a screen).

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Sediment retention / trapping by a buffer
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Effect OUTCOME variable (nbs_effect), not a suitability variable: share of incoming sediment load retained by the buffer. Downstream export effect, so XW routes it to soil_erosion_risk only as a component (0.7). Riparian pilot, method section 4.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Nutrient (N / P) removal by a buffer
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Effect OUTCOME variable: share of N/P load removed. NO T5 priority target exists (water_stress = scarcity, not quality) -> deliberately UNMAPPED in XW; the riparian pilot surfaces the T5 gap. Decision for the T5 owner.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Streambank erosion / bank instability
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Effect OUTCOME variable (high_is_bad): bank erosion / instability. XW -> soil_erosion_risk as a component (0.7, inverted).

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Stream / water temperature (thermal buffering)
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Effect OUTCOME variable (aquatic thermal buffering by shade). No T5 target (heat_stress_hazard is terrestrial) -> UNMAPPED; catalogued for a future aquatic-habitat layer.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Livestock productivity (milk / liveweight gain / stocking rate)
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: The central outcome of every silvopastoral source (ES/PT/FR + the Colombia CMSCR ICR). Without it the T6 production_gap cell for silvopastoral is built from CROP yield only. Mixed units (kg/animal/day, L/cow/day, %, head/ha) so canonical_unit is unitless and magnitudes carry their own unit.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Forage / herbaceous biomass productivity under tree canopy
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Fodder supply under canopy; a mechanism component of livestock productivity (Sahel parkland + LatAm silvopasture).

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Establishment survival / restoration success
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Share of planted / regenerating stems surviving or sites meeting establishment targets — the outcome a hazard damages in asset-vulnerability units for plantings (FR effect round 1). Effect-side only (no T4 dataset).

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Water yield / streamflow
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: QUANTITY of water leaving a catchment (annual yield, baseflow, spring/stream discharge) — distinct from water_regulation (flow buffering / timing). Split 2026-10-07 (round-3 ontology gap, FR + WH): 16 units re-labelled from water_regulation with raw_name kept.

VONT_variable_ontology.label: Yield stability across seasons
VONT_variable_ontology.comment: Stability of yield across seasons / climates (higher = more stable; a LOWER variability finding is encoded as a positive direction). Distinct from crop_yield level. Split 2026-10-07 (drought-year round 2 followup): 9 units re-labelled from crop_yield with raw_name kept.

BIND_dataset_binding.fitness_note: 30 m SRTM; derive-then-aggregate for slope.
CHELSA v2.1 BIO12 (annual precip) — bias-corrected high-res; preferred over CHIRPS for static climatology.
MapSPAM ~10 km harvested-area fraction — coarse global default.
National EO cocoa map (~10 m, 2023) known to exist; upload to override MapSPAM for the SLE pilot.
CHELSA BIO1 = annual mean temperature; multi-band asset, band-resolved via this binding.
Cropping-rainfed yield gap — GAEZ v4 attainable-vs-actual or MapSPAM-derived; pilot binding to be uploaded.
Cropping-irrigated yield gap — GAEZ v4 irrigated attainable-vs-actual; pilot binding to be uploaded.
Mixed systems: composite of crop yield gap and livestock-productivity gap; livestock side often thinner — flag for upload.
Rangeland NPP gap (e.g. MODIS NPP vs CASA potential); livestock side often thinner — requires_upload by default.
Agro-pastoral composite (cropping yield-gap + NPP-gap) — pilot upload.
Tree-perennial production gap — MapSPAM-based attainable for the perennial; per-crop binding (cocoa/coffee/etc.) preferred.
CHELSA BIO5 = max temperature of warmest month — proxy for heat-stress exposure; multi-band asset, band-resolved.
WB PIP subnational poverty headcount at admin1 (admin2 where available).

Derived run-time layer. Inputs: glad_global_cropland_2019 + esa_worldcereal_2021 + glw4_livestock_2020 + fao_gmia_v5 + hansen_treecover2000 + mapspam_cocoa_2020. Recipe: methodology/farming_system_classifier.md. Default thresholds; tune per AOI.
Sierra Leone tuning: irrigation_share=0.10, livestock_mixed=3.0 TLU/km2, livestock_pastoral=15.0, tree_perennial_dominant=0.40. See farming_system_classifier.md §Per-AOI tuning.
BII (Newbold et al. 2016). Global 1 km. Use (1 - BII) as priority.
Weiss/Nelson 2015 baseline ~1 km global accessibility surface. Travel-time minutes.
VIIRS annual night-lights composite at ~500 m as electrification proxy.
LandMark IPLC vector layer. FPIC_REQUIRED flag triggers on overlap with the M1 opportunity-space mask. Coverage patchy — absence ≠ no IPLC presence.
ACLED rolling 5-year event-density grid; pair with WB FCV admin0 list for binary fragility flag.
WB WGI 'government effectiveness' (admin0). Per the T5 spatial-grain rule (admin0 → qualified flag, not hotspot driver). Subnational requires_upload.
WB Global Findex (admin0). Subnational requires_upload via LSMS-ISA / FinScope.
FAOSTAT country indicators (producer prices + trade) as market-depth proxy. Subnational requires country uploads.
ILOSTAT agricultural employment share. Subnational requires LSMS-ISA or country uploads.
JRC Global Flood Hazard 100-year return period as default. WRI Aqueduct + FATHOM (proprietary) considered, JRC chosen for open + global + grid.
WRI Aqueduct 4.0 baseline water-stress index. Basin/admin1 granularity.
ILOSTAT 'employment in agriculture (% of total)' admin0 indicator. Subnational requires_upload.
UNDP Gender Inequality Index — national flag. Per T5 spatial-grain rule, surfaces as qualified flag within a country, not hotspot driver.
Same Nelson/Weiss surface as accessibility_travel_time — re-bound here for the T5 descriptor framing (market connectivity context, not scenario lever).
Lesiv et al. 2019 crowdsourced field-size dataset, ~1 km.
MapSPAM v2.0 summed crop economic value, ~10 km. Weak on tree-perennials — Forest Data Partnership (issue #35) is the supplement.
LandMark IPLC vector layer. Marks IPLC overlap with M1 opportunity-space mask for equity priority + FPIC/ESS7 flag. Coverage patchy - absence != no IPLC presence.

Derive the stream network from MERIT upstream drainage area, then Euclidean distance to it. ~90 m: the 5-30 m bands the evidence specifies are below the network's meaningful resolution - scoping-grade only, and a national hydrography upload is preferable where one exists.
30 m water-surface complement for lakes and wide rivers; does not carry the headwater network, so it supplements rank 1 rather than replacing it.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: spatMCDA — reference MCDA implementation
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Generic spatial MCDA engine: CRITIC+Entropy+AHP criterion weighting -> continuous + 4-class suitability (terra/sf). NbS-agnostic.
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: NbS-AGNOSTIC reference MCDA engine (B. Kenduiywo; AGENTS framework primitive). The committed script demos an agroforestry example, but the tool is generic — applies to any NbS. Do NOT read the demo title as an agroforestry association.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: Agroforestry social-ecological suitability (US Midwest)
TOOL_tool_registry.weighting_scheme: Per-practice environmental-priority sub-criterion weights sit on a 0–10 slider scale (wind-erosion WEI, water-erosion, soil-organic-carbon; saraheb3_af_app L268,270,285). Four top-level criteria (environmental-priority · tree-suitability · social-feasibility · economic-viability) on 0–5 (L253-256); water-quality surface/ground 0–5 step 0.5. Region-specific HUC default weight-sets preloaded. So a per-practice weight of 5 ⇒ 5/10. Provenance: gee_script app, commit af338e8251c6bde4fa46caccf4e92124f80d7623.
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Social-ecological multi-criteria suitability mapping for agroforestry
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: Accompanies IOP paper 'Mapping the social-ecological suitability of agroforestry in the US Midwest' (10.1088/1748-9326/adab09). GEE variant: saraheb3/AgroforestrySuitability_GEE. Code-level EV (per-practice env-priority weights + CDL eligibility) extracted from the GEE map script -> source saraheb3_af_map (file_line+commit_sha).

TOOL_tool_registry.name: Agroforestry Suitability Mapping with iNaturalist
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: eta-squared empirical weighting blended with XGBoost/ExtraTrees ML on iNaturalist/GBIF occurrences
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: Species-occurrence-driven (iNaturalist/GBIF) -> species_envelope flavour; outputs are species, not practice-level.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: CIFOR-ICRAF SPACIAL Dashboards
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Interactive spatial dashboards for land-use / restoration / agroforestry decision support
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: CIFOR-ICRAF interactive spatial dashboards. Scope NOT verified as agroforestry-specific (landing page unreachable on probe); ICRAF's agroforestry brand is not evidence the dashboards are agroforestry-scoped (PICOS). Tag left blank pending verification.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: WRI Atlas of Forest Landscape Restoration Opportunity
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Global/national forest landscape restoration opportunity mapping (methodology + data)
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: Forest-landscape restoration scope (not pure agroforestry) -> relevant to a future restoration recipe.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: Restoration Opportunities Assessment Methodology (ROAM)
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Phased restoration opportunity assessment; multi-criteria suitability mapping + stakeholder-defined rules
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: In stocktake grey-23 (High tier). India ROAM technical note acquired (wri_roam_india) - forest-restoration scope.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: Diversity for Restoration (D4R)
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Online DSS: habitat-suitability models (present+projected climate) + functional traits + local knowledge -> optimised, complementary species portfolios + seed-zone maps for restoration
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: Our-org tool (named in TORs). SPECIES-LEVEL (habitat suitability per species, seed sourcing) -> species-envelope realm, not practice-level spatial suitability; keep claim_scope discipline. nbs_ids blank: restoration species selection generally, not a single NbS practice. Sister tool: Diversity for Agroforestry.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: Diversity for Agroforestry (D4Ag)
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: D4R sister tool: tree-species recommendations + planting designs for cacao and coffee agroforestry systems
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: PICOS-clean: explicitly agroforestry (cacao/coffee AF). Species-level recommendations -> species-envelope; distinct from practice-level suitability. Verify exact URL/scope on review.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: BiodiversityR
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Ensemble species-distribution / suitability modelling + mapping + community-ecology stats (R-Commander GUI). CRAN.
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: SPECIES-LEVEL ensemble SDM (species-envelope), NbS-agnostic -> distinct from practice-level suitability. Maintainer R. Kindt (ICRAF). Companion species DBs (TreeGOER, GlobUNT, EcoregionsTreeFinder, Agroforestry Species Switchboard) are REPOSITORIES/grey sources, not tools.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: Extrapolation Suitability Index (ESI) + Impact-Based Spatial Targeting Index (IBSTI)
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Extrapolation-detection algorithm -> environmental dissimilarity maps (reference trial sites vs projection domain), correlation-aware -> Extrapolation Suitability Index (ESI); ESI x impact -> IBSTI priority zones. Demoed on maize+fertilizer in Tanzania.
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: Practice/technology-level spatial-targeting method (NOT species). Source: Tamene/Coe et al. 2017, hdl 10568/89935. nbs_ids blank: general ag-technology-package targeting; demo = maize+fertilizer, AF is one applicable package (PICOS). Inputs: bioclimatic layers + on-farm yield-gap data.

TOOL_tool_registry.name: Remote Sensing & Climate Data for Targeting Landscape Restoration in Africa
TOOL_tool_registry.workflow_summary: Satellite (1982-2003) + climate -> land-degradation hotspots -> simulate SLM/restoration interventions (ISFM, conservation ag, SWC, exclosures, agroforestry) with cost-benefit + trade-off for spatial land-use planning.
TOOL_tool_registry.notes: Source: Tamene et al. 2019, hdl 10568/106885. nbs_ids blank: general land-degradation/restoration targeting; agroforestry is ONE of several modelled interventions, not the subject (PICOS).
